message: I remember one evening when a sudden storm knocked out the power just as I was settling in for a cozy movie night. Luckily, I had charged up my power bank earlier that week, so I could keep my phone alive for updates. I grabbed my trusty lantern instead of fumbling around for candles, and we ended up having a little glow-in-the-dark board game session instead! It was a small win that turned a potentially frustrating night into a fun family memory. Sometimes, a little prep goes a long way in keeping the good times rolling, doesn’t it?
